artifacts.summary: Second-pass report: verdict on the variation claim (TRUE, Lean-verified), corrected frame-valued Tier 0 with an exact proved biconditional for density, negative verdict on the differentiation route with the exact collapse reason, amendment list for report 01 including a rewritten non-goal #1, and a 5-phase construction spec
Machine-checked Lean evidence file backing every verified claim in report 02; compiles under lake env lean with no sorry

key_findings: Validity varies across frames at fixed D: staticFrame validates density for all formulas over Z, natFrame refutes it (both Lean-verified)
natFrame over Z already realises every time-valuation, so transFrame is not needed for the discrete necessity engine
Exact per-frame biconditional proved over arbitrary D: F validates atomic density iff F is forward-recurrent at covering pairs
Densely-ordered D makes the condition vacuous, recovering soundness and making the correspondent uniform

Differentiation route fails at all three readings; per-history atom differentiation is exactly equal to full realisability because the admissible atom algebra is always P(D/ker sigma), complete and atomic
The splitting condition is TaskFrame.Interpolates, a frame axiom true of every task frame
Report 01 sections 2, 5.2, 6, 7 stand; section 3 O1's conclusion, O2, O3's conclusion, section 5.3's Tier-0 row, and non-goal #1 require amendment
open_items: E2 (open): does FwdRec imply every total history is periodic over non-dense D? If yes, the biconditional upgrades from the atomic fragment to the full schema. Gated; a negative is a complete outcome.
